history.title: setup / foundation
history.account: The Greyfold cooperative fitted out dry alcoves in the sinkhole cave because traveling associates needed somewhere to meet away from crowded lodgings. The aim was to host private meetings without excluding ordinary travelers. The site was chosen because the recessed approach screened the interior from passing travelers.

history.title: e1 / reuse
history.account: The Greyfold cooperative adapted the main occupied area for storage to keep supplies away from weather; the older fittings remained beside the new ones.

history.title: e2 / withdraw
history.account: The Greyfold cooperative left because they could no longer spare people to maintain both this outpost and their main home. The place was left vacant. They left a set of shelter tools in the protected dry store, intending to recover it later.

history.title: e3 / flood
history.account: Debris blocked a lower outlet; water from the runoff channel collected in a retained cavity below the dry surroundings.

history.title: e4 / collapse
history.account: A weather-exposed support failed under load and broke a service crossing.
